text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: On the way back from going shopping with Cesario—
Cesario-san!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Hello, Spe-san.
Are you out shopping or something today?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ehe, actually, I'm going out for ramen!
It's a place I go to a lot with King-chan and the others♪

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
(Spe-san's generation, overflowing with brilliant talent...
And this is the ramen shop they all frequent...)

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I've been looking forward to eel ramen since this morning...
Would the two of you like to join me if you're free?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Did you say eel...?!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Umm... Trainer.
I have a bit of interest in that shop...
choice_data_list: I haven't had lunch yet either, so let's go.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Another serving, please!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"Another refill...?! And not just extra noodles like before...
but the whole bowl from scratch...?!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ehehe... The soup was so delicious, I just couldn't resist...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: (...Why is this? Looking at Spe-san gives me an overwhelming appetite... Is something inside me...?)

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"...Trainer. I'm going to stay by Spe-san's side
to the very end today as well."
choice_data_list: What's wrong all of a sudden...?
What's wrong all of a sudden...?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I feel like something inside me... something like destiny...
is sensing a connection between that appetite and Spe-san's strength.
choice_data_list: That doesn't mean you can overeat, though.
Indeed, if the driving force behind that late burst is food...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Hm, is that so? Indeed, compared to my usual portion size, this would clearly be overeating...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"...I was almost swept away by a strange impulse.
Thank you very much."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I finished the delicious meal, leaving my stomach comfortably full.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
I... want to believe in this feeling.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Spe-san, I'll join you for seconds too!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ah, in that case, looks like you can switch
up the flavor with these seasonings♪

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much.
Now then... time for seconds!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On this day, Cesario displayed an appetite
that nearly rivaled Special Week's...
